## About
Antillon Tires is an established tire and wheel shop in Phoenix with a friendly and professional staff. We carry a large variety of name brands, from entry level options to major brands, plus new and used tires.
Our wheel alignment is performed with state of the art equipment. We also have payment options available with no credit check.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 264 reviews. Customers mention Armondo, Carmen and Josh by name.

## Services
- New Tires: A wide selection of tires with entry level options as well as major brands like Goodyear, Michelin, Yokohama, Toyo, Nitto and Continental. ($49.99 & Up)
- Used Tires: Please contact us for price and availability. ($49.99 & Up)
- Luxury Wheels: A wide selection of luxury wheels including Fuel, Niche, Foose, KMC, American Racing and Factory Reproductions. Contact us for pricing and availability.
- Alignment: Alignment service with state of the art equipment. Please contact us for a quote.
- Payment Options: Payment options are available with no credit check. Complete our application process to get started.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. Sunday hours are 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM.

Q: Do I need good credit to use your payment options?
A: No. We have payment options available with no credit check. Just complete our application process.

Q: What tire brands do you carry?
A: We carry Goodyear, Michelin, Yokohama, Toyo, Nitto, Continental and others, along with entry level options.

Q: Which wheel brands do you offer?
A: Fuel, Niche, Foose, KMC, American Racing and Factory Reproductions. Contact us for pricing and availability.
